title: Control the outputs safely
goal: Understand how output A or output B can switch a connected load remotely and how the Pro-finder reports the result, without publishing unconfirmed SMS commands.
prerequisites: The load is already wired. Output A is on pin 7 of the eight-pin connector and output B is on pin 6.
A load requiring more than 500 mA is connected through a high-quality automotive relay with a flyback diode, not directly to pin 6 or pin 7.
The Pro-finder is powered and contains a Nano-SIM.
You know the device number to which an SMS would be sent.

warnings.text: Pins 6 and 7 are transistor outputs. They provide 12 V and may be loaded with no more than 500 mA. Use a high-quality automotive relay with a flyback diode for a higher-current load. The source states that overloading voids the warranty.

sources.region: Section 1.4, third paragraph and output-control list

warnings.text: A continuously enabled output remains on until a separate command switches it off. The reviewed pages do not describe an automatic timeout for this mode.
Remote switching takes place without a view of the vehicle. Treat the returned status report as the only confirmation described by the reviewed pages.

sources.region: Section 5.3, output states in the status report

steps.text: Identify the connected load by pin number. Output A is pin 7 and output B is pin 6; the two outputs are controlled independently.

sources.region: Section 1.2, connector legend for pins 6 and 7

steps.text: Choose one of the three documented modes: continuous operation, a one-second pulse, or a selected duration from 1 to 120 minutes. Both outputs support the same modes.

Do not copy a command from another language version. The exact SMS command and the rule that distinguishes output B from output A are intentionally omitted until the manufacturer confirms the command language.
steps.expected: The required operating mode is understood, but no unconfirmed command has been sent.

sources.region: Sections 5.5.1 to 5.5.3 and the red note at the bottom of the page
sources.note: Four command lines and the output-B substitution rule are present in the source but remain blocked by BLK-005.

steps.text: After a technically confirmed command becomes available, send only that confirmed command to the Pro-finder. The source says that switching is followed by an SMS status report.
steps.expected: The selected output changes state and the Pro-finder returns a status report.

sources.region: Sections 5.5.1 to 5.5.3, action and response sentences

steps.text: For continuous operation, switch the output off again with a separate confirmed command. A pulse ends after one second; a timed operation ends after the selected number of minutes.
Read the returned status report and verify the states of both outputs. If no report arrives, do not assume that switching succeeded.
steps.expected: The report confirms the expected state of the selected output.

sources.region: Section 5.3, output states in the status report

expected_result: The intended output mode, duration, connector pin and confirmation method are understood. The task remains deliberately non-executable until the manufacturer confirms the SMS command set; no command is inferred from a translated manual.

error_cases.problem: The load requires more than 500 mA.
error_cases.correction: Do not connect it directly to pin 6 or pin 7. Use a high-quality automotive relay with a flyback diode. The source states that overloading voids the warranty.

error_cases.problem: No status report arrives after a switching attempt.
error_cases.correction: Treat the operation as unconfirmed. The source describes a status report after each output change. Do not repeat the command blindly. A report can also be requested by calling outside operating modes 2 and 3, but the source limits this call response to authorised numbers.

error_cases.problem: The load must run longer than the adjustable timed range.
error_cases.correction: The documented timed range is 1 to 120 minutes. The source offers continuous operation for a longer period, which then requires an explicit switch-off. It does not state what happens with an out-of-range value.

error_cases.problem: A running timed operation must be stopped early.
error_cases.correction: The reviewed pages do not say whether a timed operation can be cancelled. Do not infer a command; obtain technical confirmation from the manufacturer.

Electrical ratings, connector pins, durations and the status-report limitation are preserved. Technical and independent English-language reviews are pending.
